assessments.summary: The source-level argument verifies the subclass partition, the 1,444 off-diagonal four-cell orbit variables and 38 diagonal antipodal-pair variables, the unique 38-plus-1 selection encoding of 154-point subclass members, completeness of maximal primitive-line enumeration, and soundness and completeness of the weighted no-three-in-line inequalities. However, the material assertions that canonical deduplication yields exactly 388,148 constraints and that the serialization has SHA-256 digest 5c0051739717f52f8eddd00cd01e8a83030849b3fd7b4516b0d308882c9aaf62 were not independently recomputed or otherwise established. No decisive defect was found, but these unresolved exact computational obligations prevent validity.
scopeQualifications: The claim concerns only the explicitly defined rct4 subclass at n=77.
It does not assert satisfiability or infeasibility.
It does not cover general half-turn, reflection-symmetric, or asymmetric configurations.
It does not classify all rotations or alter bounds on D(77).
evidenceIssues: No complete serialized constraint list or independently verified successful execution trace was supplied.
results.json merely repeats the asserted count and digest and does not establish that executing the generator produces them.
An exact replay of `python3 verify_rct4_instance.py results` with confirmed successful completion is needed to verify the count and digest.
